# Configurable volatility thresholds per TCG/edition

Description

Make volatility thresholds configurable by TCG and edition and expose controls in Admin so pricing sync respects different markets.

Acceptance criteria

- Data model supports thresholds per TCG/edition.
- Admin UI to configure thresholds.
- Sync job reads thresholds and applies rules accordingly.
